notes: Read the 66-line source hook line by line before editing and ported the CommandResult and SendCommandParams interfaces, POST /vehicles/{vehicleId}/command mutation body, success/error handling, auth-expired branch, and all cache invalidation keys.

Source is non-visual API/type hook code; the native output uses the React Native-safe parity request client and Alert-backed mutation toast helper, with no DOM modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or web UI imports.

The web-only document event used by queueTeslaMutation cannot exist in React Native, so the native hook explicitly reports documentEventBridgeAvailable=false and exposes a bounded in-memory queue plus drainQueuedTeslaCommandMutations for replay after native Tesla reconnect.
